paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : Linguistic and geographic trends over time in harmful language research. Notably, the number of datasets for the non-top five languages continues to be lower than all English ones, while since 2017 we see more and more datasets in languages other than English.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets related to harmful language research over time, categorized by language. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with tick labels indicating each year. The vertical axis represents the “Number of datasets,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, marked in increments of 100. The bars are colored by language: blue for English, orange for All other, green for Arabic, magenta for Bengali, yellow for Spanish, and brown for Russian.  The English datasets consistently have the highest bar heights, with values ranging from approximately 750 in 2012 to 980 in 2022. The ‘All other’ datasets show fluctuating values, starting at approximately 100 in 2012 and reaching a peak of 350 in 2021. The Arabic datasets are consistently lower than English and “All other” datasets, ranging from approximately 30 in 2012 to 80 in 2022. Bengali, Spanish, and Russian datasets all consistently have the lowest bar heights, with values typically below 50, and are generally lower than all other languages. The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
